literal_meaning: ডকে উঠে যাওয়া (শিপ বা নৌকা ডকে উঠে যাওয়া)
figurative_meaning_en: to collapse or fail, especially in business
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পটি ডকে উঠে গেছে, কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: His business has completely gone under.
This project has failed; it's gone belly up with no profit.
note: Origin likely from maritime trade in Bengali ports like Kolkata, where docking symbolizes the end or failure of a venture.
